# infisical_secret_validation_rule_static_secrets (Resource)

Create and manage Secret Validation Rules for Static Secrets

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_secret_validation_rule_static_secrets" "static-secrets" {
  name        = "static-secrets-validation-rule-example"
  project_id  = "<project-id>"
  environment = "<environment-slug>" # Omit to enforce the rule in every environment of the project
  secret_path = "/**"                # Supports glob patterns such as /apps/**

  constraints = {
    key_constraints = {
      regex_pattern   = "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$"
      required_prefix = "APP_"
    }

    value_constraints = {
      min_length        = 16
      max_length        = 128
      previous_versions = 10
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `constraints` (Attributes) The constraints this Static Secrets rule enforces. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--constraints))
- `name` (String) The name of the secret validation rule.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Infisical project to create the secret validation rule in.
- `secret_path` (String) The secret path to scope this rule to. Supports glob patterns such as `/apps/**`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the secret validation rule.
- `environment` (String) The slug of the environment to scope this rule to. Omit to enforce the rule in every environment of the project.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced. An inactive rule is kept but ignored. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the secret validation rule.

<a id="nestedatt--constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `constraints`

Optional:

- `key_constraints` (Attributes) Constraints enforced on the secret key when a secret is created or renamed. Omit to leave keys unconstrained. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--constraints--key_constraints))
- `value_constraints` (Attributes) Constraints enforced on the secret value when a secret is created or updated. Omit to leave values unconstrained. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--constraints--value_constraints))

<a id="nestedatt--constraints--key_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `constraints.key_constraints`

Optional:

- `max_length` (Number) The maximum number of characters the secret key may contain.
- `min_length` (Number) The minimum number of characters the secret key must contain.
- `regex_pattern` (String) A regular expression the secret key must match.
- `required_prefix` (String) A string the secret key must start with.
- `required_suffix` (String) A string the secret key must end with.


<a id="nestedatt--constraints--value_constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `constraints.value_constraints`

Optional:

- `max_length` (Number) The maximum number of characters the secret value may contain.
- `min_length` (Number) The minimum number of characters the secret value must contain.
- `previous_versions` (Number) How many of the secret's own previous versions the new value must differ from. Between 1 and 25. Omit to allow a value that repeats a previous version.
- `regex_pattern` (String) A regular expression the secret value must match.
- `required_prefix` (String) A string the secret value must start with.
- `required_suffix` (String) A string the secret value must end with.
- `unique_within_scope` (Boolean) Set to `true` to reject a value that another secret in the rule's scope already holds. Requires blind indexing on the project. Omit to allow a value another secret already holds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the static secrets validation rule by its ID
terraform import infisical_secret_validation_rule_static_secrets.example <rule_id>
```
